items.title: Adopt standing brief and reconcile scope
acceptanceCriteria: Persist owner authority and preserved boundaries.
Link the active queue from agent and start documents.
Keep empirical claims separate from synthetic-alpha release acceptance.

items.title: Review and integrate outstanding research intake
acceptanceCriteria: Inspect b93bccb and verify its evidence hashes.
Run targeted intake and metadata-filter tests.
Merge only after final-diff review and green Linux/Windows CI.

items.title: Player pages with persistent format filters
acceptanceCriteria: Open a player by stable ID from squad and statistics.
Separate base skills, condition and recorded performance.
Persist format filters and explain missing statistics.

items.title: Pre-match pitch and conditions inspection
acceptanceCriteria: Show the selected ground and effective pitch parameters before toss.
Explain disabled model effects without implying gameplay influence.
Keep forecasts separate from hidden future schedules.

items.title: Names and colours in a new-game world copy
acceptanceCriteria: Edit names and colours without changing stable entity IDs.
Version and validate the new-game world copy.
Preserve historical match snapshots and escape all rendered text.

items.title: Validated new-game roster import
acceptanceCriteria: Stage imported worlds with size, schema and reference validation.
Apply explicit priors for permitted missing statistical data.
Reject executable content, invalid XIs and malformed rosters.
Preserve export/import of referenced custom packs.

items.title: Complete basic settings and player navigation
acceptanceCriteria: Add the specified 115 percent text scale.
Keep keyboard focus, reduced motion and narrow layouts usable.
Retain player identity and format filter across navigation.

items.title: Broader bounded simulation scopes
acceptanceCriteria: Add next-decision, innings and match scopes.
Stop at every required decision and commit boundary.
Prove scope choices do not change accepted results.

items.title: Cancellation and boundary-applied commands
acceptanceCriteria: Cancel long batches at safe boundaries.
Report the accepted sequence for queued commands.
Reject stale revisions without advancing random counters.

items.title: Granular user delegation
acceptanceCriteria: Delegate each supported decision category explicitly.
Record delegation in command history and save/replay.
Keep unsupported categories disabled.

items.title: Match continuity across management navigation
acceptanceCriteria: Keep the active match authority alive while inspecting management screens.
Restore projections without a second engine or duplicate commands.
Preserve durable recovery if the application closes.

items.title: Analytics across enabled formats
acceptanceCriteria: Extend event-derived analytics to ODI and red ball.
Reconcile scorecards and handle follow-on innings order.
Show a dedicated fall-of-wickets view.

items.title: Incremental analytics and rebuild controls
acceptanceCriteria: Track applied sequence and reject gaps or duplicate application.
Match incremental output to a full rebuild.
Expose background rebuild progress and cancellation.

items.title: Complete analytical charts
acceptanceCriteria: Render a score worm and a shot-sector wagon wheel.
Preserve left-handed view transforms without changing stored events.
Show categorical executed pitch maps only where data exists.
Never invent measured trajectories or extras shot locations.

items.title: CSV and printable scorecards
acceptanceCriteria: Export UTF-8 CSV with formula-prefix protection.
Provide printable HTML with format, rules and model status.
Test escaping, missing values and score reconciliation.

items.title: Previewable diagnostic event exports
acceptanceCriteria: Export canonical event data with version and failure metadata.
Make export opt-in and previewable.
Keep private data and raw licensed research out of automatic uploads.

items.title: Manual career save copies
acceptanceCriteria: Create a named career copy without altering the source slot.
Respect writer leases and revisions.
Prove reload and portable round-trip equivalence.

items.title: Completed career event archives and replay
acceptanceCriteria: Retain versioned completed-match event history.
Expose replay without recomputing new historical outcomes.
Bound storage and archive sizes with explicit recovery behaviour.
Preserve existing v1 careers without silent migration.

items.title: Career save and recovery usability
acceptanceCriteria: Explain save errors and recovery choices clearly.
Retain corrupted originals and offer validated older generations.
Keep manual copies, import and export keyboard accessible.

items.title: ODI tactical captain
acceptanceCriteria: Use public observations and accepted ODI commands.
Respect quotas, field phases and remaining resources.
Record repeatable legal decisions with no hidden bonuses.

items.title: Red-ball tactical captain
acceptanceCriteria: Use lead, wickets and remaining time in legal choices.
Keep workload and field decisions within the selected profile.
Preserve manual control for undelegated categories.

items.title: Declaration and follow-on evaluation
acceptanceCriteria: Compare cloned continuations without consuming live random draws.
Use an explicit versioned utility and planning budget.
Test declaration, follow-on, innings win and draw cases.

items.title: Seeded weather and uncertain forecasts
acceptanceCriteria: Generate versioned segments in an independent random domain.
Apply interruptions only at safe event boundaries.
Show uncertain forecasts without revealing the hidden schedule.
Preserve clock fixtures and keep limited-overs rain disabled.

items.title: Synthetic quality and tactical exploitation gates
acceptanceCriteria: Run fixed paired scenarios across skills, fields and pitches.
Investigate the documented low-scoring baseline.
Record monotonicity, dominant tactics and supported claims.
Use a new version for any changed result-generating behaviour.

items.title: Cross-format replay and release-scale diagnostics
acceptanceCriteria: Run at least 100 fixed replay matches per enabled format.
Run the specified 10000 simulations per format with reproducible seeds.
Report innings, phases, tails, uncertainty and stopping conditions.
Make synthetic claims without claiming empirical calibration.

items.title: Accessibility release audit
acceptanceCriteria: Verify keyboard, focus, contrast, screen-reader behaviour and browser zoom.
Retain 150 percent, long-name and narrow-layout browser checks.
Record remaining human observations without fabricating metadata.

items.title: Offline assets and safe updates
acceptanceCriteria: Verify offline asset availability and startup.
Offer updates outside active transactions.
Retain supported engine assets or an explicit recovery build.

items.title: Reference-hardware performance acceptance
acceptanceCriteria: Measure all eight budgets on a recorded qualifying host.
Include worker and native allocations in total application memory.
Keep cloud observations separate from reference acceptance.

items.title: Release record and packaging
acceptanceCriteria: Reconcile every advertised capability with passing evidence.
Package the tested commit, manifests, known limits and recovery instructions.
Record owner-PC and human evidence honestly.
Keep public deployment separately authorised.

items.title: Historical incident decisions and executable packets
acceptanceCriteria: Obtain missing incident facts and cited decisions.
Run complete expected prefixes through the reviewed-packet runner.
Retain rejected and inconclusive cases.

items.title: Untouched empirical evaluation cohort
acceptanceCriteria: Obtain at least 200 eligible forward evaluation matches and the required training cohort.
Freeze candidate and protocol before outcome opening.
Preserve rights, source hashes and exclusions.

items.title: Empirical candidate and promotion review
acceptanceCriteria: Evaluate both innings, strengths, fatigue and tactics with uncertainty.
Preserve old model and save dispatch.
Obtain separate explicit approval before gameplay promotion.
